summary: Completed comprehensive testing of RACCOON APP - Admin Security, Premium Feature Gating, Matching Filters, and Social Auth UI. All 8 requested features verified successfully.

test_credentials.guest_user: No credentials needed - click Start Matching on /guest page

context_for_next_testing_agent: All features working correctly. Admin panel shows 7 stat cards. Guest users see Access Denied for /admin. Game cards show lock icons for non-premium users. Matching Filters modal works with Gender and Country preferences. Firebase Auth buttons (Google, Apple, Phone) are MOCKED - visible but require Firebase config to fully work.

admin_login.details: Admin login with admin@raccoon.app / Admin123! works correctly. Returns is_admin=true and premium_status=true

admin_panel_stats.details: Admin panel at /admin shows all 7 stat cards: Total Users, Premium Users, Banned Users, Active Today, Total Matches, Messages Today, Guest Users

guest_admin_access_denied.details: Guest users trying to access /admin see 'Access Denied' page with message 'You don't have permission to access the Admin Panel'

matching_filters_modal.details: Filter button visible on Match page during searching state. Clicking opens Matching Filters modal

matching_filters_options.details: Modal shows Gender Preference (Anyone, Male, Female) and Country Preference dropdown. Non-premium users see 'Filters are a Premium feature' warning

social_auth_buttons.details: Login page shows Google, Apple, and Phone Number social auth buttons. MOCKED - require Firebase config to fully work

dashboard_game_locks.details: Dashboard game cards (Raccoon Feud, Truth or Dare) show lock icons and 'PREMIUM' badge for non-premium users

locked_game_redirect.details: Clicking locked game card redirects to /premium page with toast 'Raccoon Feud is a Premium feature'

mocked_apis_confirmed: Firebase Authentication (Google/Apple/Phone) - buttons visible but require Firebase config to fully work

backend_api_tests.test_admin_login_success: PASS - Admin login returns correct user with is_admin=true
backend_api_tests.test_admin_users_endpoint: PASS - Returns users list with stats
